task.notes: Tries K9: fold T3/Gata4rep1->rep2 with the released wild-type series added for the reference's revert.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

raw.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition

raw_r8.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw_r8.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_r8.r8: y - (y . u) u then eb_factor.finalize, y gene_factor's log ratio as raw_c3 takes it, u the rank-1 uncentred SVD direction of the wild-type series' interior-stage residuals per K7b group (R2's weights), each first cleaned of its part monotone in the reference's mean expression (H20's level_monotone_fit)

raw_r8_perm.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_r8_perm.r8: y - (y . u) u then eb_factor.finalize, y gene_factor's log ratio as raw_c3 takes it, u the rank-1 uncentred SVD direction of the wild-type series' interior-stage residuals per K7b group (R2's weights), each first cleaned of its part monotone in the reference's mean expression (H20's level_monotone_fit)
raw_r8_perm.r8_perm: as raw_r8 with u permuted across genes within deciles of the reference's t3_mean_expression (harness.t3_decile_permutation, k9.PERM_SEED)
